description: E001 is reported as a dockers’ work stoppage/protest movement on 28 February, but the opened reports do not establish a distinct public gathering or any site-specific simultaneous attendance. The ≥50 threshold is unknown.
required_followup: Search for a permitted contemporary dockworker/port report, union statement or independent witness account describing the 28 February action as an assembly and giving a site-specific crowd estimate; otherwise retain pending_evidence.

description: Bénin Intelligent on 10 March quotes an appeal to the President about port reforms and dockers’ conditions, but does not establish that the detailed state-directed demand was voiced during the 28 February action. Banouto instead documents the immediate wage dispute with the Bureau d’embauche unique.
required_followup: Seek contemporary public-action evidence linking the 28 February dockers’ action to a demand on government/state policy; do not infer that employer wage negotiations are a state demand.

description: Open-web searching in French and English covered general queries, four week windows, local outlets, a regional outlet, labor/education sectors, official-source discovery and a retrospective query. Results were repetitive and dominated by the 28 February dockers report; no systematic newspaper archive or LexisNexis review was performed. Native search clocks, totals and native ordering metadata were not exposed.
required_followup: Continue feasible local-language discovery with unions, local reporting and sector/date-specific searches if resolving the candidate; do not claim that no other protests occurred.
